identity.name: Resellr OS
identity.tone: Expensive yet functional. Not a spreadsheet, but a workspace.

typography.instructions: Use Playfair Display for large metrics (Net Profit) and Section Headers. Use Mulish for all UI text, labels, and lists. Use Space Mono for SKU numbers or data tables.

layout_rules.safe_area: Always wrap main screen content in SafeAreaView or use useSafeAreaInsets.
layout_rules.tab_bar: Custom implementation required. Height 80px, no top border, floating effect or clean flat integration.
layout_rules.charts: Custom SVG charts only. Use react-native-svg. Minimal line charts with Bezier curves. No grid lines. Only x-axis labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install expo-google-fonts for Playfair Display and Mulish.
Use StyleSheet.create for all styles. NO inline styles for complex layouts.
Use the specific color palette provided. Do not use generic 'black' or 'white'.
Ensure hit slop is added to all small touchable elements.
For the 'Source Calculator', use a large numeric keypad input design, not the native keyboard.
Implement the 'Pipeline' as a horizontal scrollable view with cards for each stage.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
